compatibility_probe.source:
import LeanSemanticPrimitives.Compiler.DirectVsCompiled
import LeanSemanticPrimitives.Compiler.DirectExamples
open Compiler
#print axioms interpretDesign_allEdges
#print axioms compileDesign_correct
#print axioms compileAndRun_correct
#print axioms Direct.directStep_eq_compileAndRun
-- Valid defaults recover old all-fire semantics.
def defaultD : DesignCert := { sources := #[.const 8 7], nodes := #[], outputs := #[], flops := #[{ width := 8, din := 0, enable := none, resetPin := none, resetValue := 0, resetActiveLow := false }], memories := #[] }
#guard (interpretDesign defaultD (allEdges defaultD) #[] { flops := #[mk_bv 8 1], mems := #[] }).nextState.flops = (interpretDesignLegacy defaultD #[] { flops := #[mk_bv 8 1], mems := #[] }).nextState.flops
-- The compiler's Bool does not establish clock ordinal well-formedness.
def undeclaredD : DesignCert := { defaultD with clocks := #[] }
#guard compilesOk undeclaredD
#guard (interpretDesign undeclaredD (allEdges undeclaredD) #[] { flops := #[mk_bv 8 1], mems := #[] }).nextState.flops = #[mk_bv 8 1]
#guard (interpretDesignLegacy undeclaredD #[] { flops := #[mk_bv 8 1], mems := #[] }).nextState.flops = #[mk_bv 8 7]
-- Generic edge-aware compiler theorem still agrees, including quiet state.
#guard (compileAndRun undeclaredD (allEdges undeclaredD) #[] { flops := #[mk_bv 8 1], mems := #[] }).nextState.flops = #[mk_bv 8 1]
#guard (Direct.checkDesign undeclaredD).isOk = false

edge_boundary_probe.source:
import D2PlanProbe
open Compiler
-- fires has no DesignCert argument: an entry can fire even when its ordinal
-- is not declared by a particular certificate. Checked runs reject the shape.
#guard fires #[false, true] 1
#guard !(fires #[true] 1)
#guard (Direct.checkRuntime defaultD #[true, true] #[] { flops := #[mk_bv 8 1], mems := #[] }).isOk = false

findings.title: required compiler port omitted
findings.evidence: The 177-edit subtotal covers three modules only. ResidualIR (6), ResidualSemantics (22) and CompileDesign (35) also change: 240 added/deleted lines across six modules.
findings.required_gate: Port all six as one dependency-consistent slice with the eight Direct modules. Carry clock and asyncReset through compileFlop/compileMemory; generalize residual commit rules, denoteResidual and compileAndRun plus correctness proofs to arbitrary ClockEdges.

findings.title: compatibility claim needs hypotheses
findings.evidence: interpretDesign_allEdges requires every flop and memory clock ordinal in bounds. Defaults satisfy this, but compilesOk alone does not. An isolated fresh probe shows an accepted certificate with empty clocks holds under allEdges while Legacy updates.
findings.required_gate: Keep generic edge-aware compiler correctness and separately validate clock metadata. Prove the valid allEdges compatibility corollary with explicit bounds. Old clockless certificates preserve old interpreter behavior, not reconstructed RTL provenance.

findings.title: edge-vector fail-safe misstated
findings.evidence: fires only reads an edge-array entry; it has no DesignCert argument. A present entry beyond the declared domains can still fire. Direct checkRuntime rejects wrong vector length.
findings.required_gate: Describe missing edge entries as false; require clock-bound and edge-length checks for checked runs. Do not equate compile acceptance with design/runtime well-formedness.

findings.title: gated-clock port must retain refusal
findings.evidence: D2 IR_Semantics_pass.cpp refuses recognized gated cones before commit_class resolution, and refuses falling-edge commits. It does not discard the gate enables and accept the root ordinal.
findings.required_gate: Preserve these refusal gates using current clock analysis APIs. Accept only normalized gates whose enable is already represented, or obtain a separately reviewed lowering; root-only classification is not equivalent.

findings.title: memory premise is false on current master
findings.evidence: Current memory cells have per-port clock_pin with global polarity. Current single_edge skips memory during plan collection and refuses divider cases; memory-mixed-edge exists on D2, not here.
findings.required_gate: Validate every committing write and synchronous read port in the Lean scanner itself. Require one root/domain and supported polarity or refuse; do not modify native/single_edge code. Include synthetic read flops and synchronous ROMs without MemoryDesc.

findings.title: clock bus identity needs current-master guard
findings.evidence: Commit_class.net_key keys a root input by name and omits selected bit. Current single_edge separately tracks clock bus bits and refuses ambiguity. Copying only D2 root keys can merge distinct clks[0]/clks[1] domains.
findings.required_gate: Preserve current bus-bit discrimination or refuse ambiguous/unresolved selections. Add same-bit, distinct-bit and undecidable-bit controls; compute implicit joins after resolving actual domains.

findings.title: typed IR and lowering path omitted
findings.evidence: Current CertificateIR has no clock table or driver clock fields; normal flops and synthetic memory read flops are built separately. emit_design_cert consumes the IR, not graph handles.
findings.required_gate: Carry owned provenance through DesignScan, CertificateIR, certificate_ir.cpp and memory_lowering.cpp to pure emission. Initialize asyncReset consistently with source descriptors, preserve ordering and roundtrip after graph close.

findings.title: call-site radius is larger than two tracked files
findings.evidence: Tracked compiler_smoke, design_scan_test, check_legacy_oracles and MaskEndpointPort call interpretDesign/compileAndRun/denoteResidual. Their current APIs also change.
findings.required_gate: Update active tracked callers and script generators, preserving old allEdges comparison procedures. Treat 943 as the prior planning snapshot textual artifact count, not the fresh acceptance matrix; retain historical artifacts and generate new outputs/manifests.

findings.title: validation scope is too narrow
findings.evidence: 77 READY is triage; historical 54/147 checker regressions are not the current matrix. The preserved replay includes 125 CORE-ET and 61 CVA6 configurations, all three DINO variants and mode-specific gates.
findings.required_gate: Run the authoritative configuration/artifact manifests, mark every frontend/refusal disposition, remeasure current async mismatches and prove full per-mode results. Keep user-owned flat-record/toolchain limitations separate.

findings.title: sidecar/tooling retention not assigned
findings.evidence: D2 exporter emits an IO/clock ordinal sidecar with runtime_input_arity and used_by_model markers and handles staged pair publication. D2 scripts and audit tools are separate contributions.
findings.required_gate: Assign source/destination/disposition to sidecar, validation/trace tools and publication tests. Preserve ordinal gaps and clocks; label pair rollback accurately without claiming crash atomicity.
